INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.

3. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.

4. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

5. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

7. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

8. When practising Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Poetry.

9. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

10. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

11. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening: Poetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
